title: Mediterranean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful gluten-free stew filled with Mediterranean flavors and sweet touches.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, red wine (if using), olives, and bell peppers.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the beef is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley, if desired.
